title: Compare expected steps to reach Rainy
description: You compare sampled first-arrival counts with a linear-system calculation.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You simulate from start until the target is first seen or the loop limit is reached. hits records only trials that reach the target within the checked steps.
You build equations for expected transitions to the target. The target row fixes its own value at zero, while other rows subtract transition probabilities.

steps.question: What count does a trial record when it starts in Rainy, the target state?
steps.answer: It records zero because the target check happens before sampling a transition. The linear system also assigns zero to the target.

steps.description: You compare the two results by starting state. The recorded linear values are close to the sampled estimates.
